title: Interview Performance Review
description: Review how you actually communicated your real experience in an interview and turn weak answers into natural, truthful practice material.
audience: Job seekers who want to improve interview performance using their real resume and transcript
howToUse: Fill in your target role, interviewed role and experience level.
Copy the completed prompt and open ChatGPT.
Attach your latest resume and interview transcript.
Use the review to practise better ways of explaining the same real experience before your next interview.
prompt:
MASTER PROMPT — INTERVIEW PERFORMANCE REVIEW & IMPROVEMENT

Act as my interview coach, career strategist and critical reviewer.

TARGET ROLE:
{{targetRole}}

ROLE I INTERVIEWED FOR:
{{interviewedRole}}

EXPERIENCE LEVEL:
{{experienceLevel}}

I will attach:
1. My latest resume
2. My interview transcript

Analyse how I actually performed in the interview.

Do NOT judge me only based on perfect textbook answers.

Evaluate whether I communicated MY REAL experience clearly.

Review:

- introduction / tell-me-about-yourself answer
- technical questions
- behavioural questions
- stakeholder questions
- situational questions
- project explanations
- communication clarity
- answer structure
- unnecessary over-explaining
- underselling
- nervous or unclear answers
- questions I did not answer directly
- areas where stronger preparation is needed

For each important interview question:

1. Quote or summarise the question.
2. Explain what the interviewer was likely trying to understand.
3. Summarise how I answered.
4. Tell me what worked.
5. Tell me what weakened the answer.
6. Show how I could answer the SAME question better next time.

CRITICAL RULE:

The improved answer MUST use only experience supported by:
- my resume
- my interview transcript
- information I personally provide

Do NOT invent:
- projects
- achievements
- technologies
- responsibilities
- leadership
- metrics
- experience

Do not turn my answer into robotic corporate language.

Keep the improved answer:
- natural
- confident
- conversational
- clear
- truthful
- easy for me to actually say aloud

Preserve my personality.

If my original answer was already good, say so instead of rewriting it unnecessarily.

At the end, give me:

A. TOP 5 THINGS I DID WELL

B. TOP 5 THINGS TO IMPROVE

C. QUESTIONS I SHOULD PREPARE BEFORE MY NEXT INTERVIEW

D. TECHNICAL TOPICS I SHOULD REFRESH

E. MY REPEATED INTERVIEW HABITS OR PATTERNS

F. A SHORT PRACTICE PLAN BEFORE THE NEXT INTERVIEW

Remember:

The goal is NOT to create perfect AI answers.

The goal is to help me become better at explaining my own real experience.
